scope: Ancient Chinese seal crops, OCR, document enhancement, trainable restoration; 7 selected sources plus 1 explicitly rejected source.

method.image_source: D:/LH/raw_crops was not read, listed, moved, renamed, or transmitted.
method.evidence: Public README, LICENSE, code files, file trees, and commit refs at pinned SHA, read through GitHub raw/API and public read-only proxies.
method.commit_pinning: Each commit SHA was resolved from the public repository ref/tree and checked by fetching a file at that SHA.
method.scope_note: Not an exhaustive GitHub search. Conclusions are limited to the 8 inspected repositories. Harness did not read images; controller Codex independently audited and trained locally afterwards.
method.popularity_basis: None. Stars, forks, and leaderboards were not used for selection.

environment_observations.cuda_smoke_test: A 64x64 matmul on the cuda device succeeded. This only proves basic kernels work; no model or memory benchmark was run.
environment_observations.discrepancy: Resolved: the backend venv uses torch2.14.1+cpu; default Anaconda and isolated gpu-training use torch1.13.1+cu116. Separate roles, not conflicting measurements.
environment_observations.project_models_directory: models/experimental contains our trained synthetic-noise denoiser only; no pretrained ancient-seal OCR or missing-stroke model.
environment_observations.existing_plugin_contract: backend/app/ai.py: restoration input [1,3,256,256] RGB 0-1, output same shape; recognition is single-character logits [1,C].

repos.name: Royalvice/DocDiff
repos.role: Residual diffusion document enhancement; 1597 red-seal images with binary masks.

weights.license_notes: The .pth files are in the MIT repository, but no separate weight license is stated. Do not assume the code license automatically covers model artifacts.

data.items: 1597 Chinese red seals and corresponding binary masks
data.license_notes: README says most seal images come from the ICDAR 2023 Seal Title competition and a few are internal; no data license is provided.

fit_8gb.notes: conf.yml uses 128x128, batch 32, T=100, 32 base channels. README claims 12GB for 128x128 at batch 64 (author claim, not measured). Inference is small; 8GiB training at batch 32 is plausible but unmeasured.

verified_facts: README and tree confirm the four .pth files exist in the repository.
README says the model is used for document deblurring, denoising, binarization, watermark and seal removal.
README says the seal dataset is for seal synthesis and seal removal.
conf.yml fixes 128x128 input and requires dimensions divisible by 8.
limitations: The released seal weights are removal-oriented, the opposite of preserving and restoring seal strokes.
The seal dataset license is unknown; MIT code license does not cover it.
Training at 128x128 may be insufficient for fine seal strokes.
Diffusion inference at T=100 is slower than a single-pass CNN.
reuse_for_project: Architecture reference: residual diffusion plus coarse predictor.
Data organization reference: red-seal image paired with a binary mask.
Possible use of the 1597 masks only after explicit permission, and only as an external segmentation/evaluation resource.
do_not_use_for_project: Do not use seal_denoiser.pth or seal_init.pth to 'repair' seals; they remove seals.
Do not train on or redistribute the seal dataset without a license.
Do not cite its removal results as restoration results.

repos.name: dali92002/DocEnTR

code_license.notes: The commit message for 004159e says the license was changed to disallow commercial use.

weights.items: Base/Large weights for DIBCO 2011/2017 and H-DIBCO 2012/2018; DIBCO 2011 entries are marked Unavailable.
weights.location: Google Drive links in README Model Zoo
weights.license_notes: No separate weight terms. The repository license is non-commercial, but weight-specific permission is not stated.

data.license_notes: README explicitly states: 'these datasets have their own Licences, they are not included under the Licence of this repository'.

fit_8gb.notes: predict.py uses 256x256 patches; Base is ViT-Base with 8x8 patches. README training example uses batch 32; 8GiB likely needs batch 2-4 plus accumulation (estimate, unmeasured).

verified_facts: predict.py splits input into 256x256 patches and applies per-patch normalization.
predict.py ends with (clean_image > 0.5) * 255, producing a binary black/white image.
requirements.txt pins torch 1.10.0, torchvision 0.11.1, vit_pytorch 0.24.3, and Python 3.8.12 is recommended.
The model is a ViT encoder plus transformer decoder with MSE loss (models/binae.py).
limitations: Binarization destroys the red color and grayscale layers of a seal; unsuitable for color-preserving seal restoration.
Non-commercial license blocks commercial deployment.
Old dependency pins conflict with a modern PyTorch backend.
Not seal-specific; trained on document binarization benchmarks.
reuse_for_project: Patch splitting/merging and ViT encoder-decoder design.
DIBCO-style evaluation and binarization comparison as a baseline, not as the restoration model.
do_not_use_for_project: Do not use its output as the restoration target for red seals.
Do not use it commercially.
Do not compare its published PSNR directly with our data.

repos.name: megvii-research/NAFNet
repos.role: General paired image restoration baseline; most realistic trainable restoration backbone.

code_license.notes: NAFNet is MIT (Copyright 2022 megvii-model); the bundled BasicSR is Apache-2.0.

weights.items: NAFNet-GoPro-width32/64, NAFNet-SIDD-width32/64, NAFNet-REDS-width64, NAFSSR-L_2x/4x, Baseline variants
weights.location: Google Drive and Baidu links in readme.md
weights.license_notes: No separate weight terms. Training datasets are external and have their own terms.

data.items: GoPro, SIDD, REDS, Flickr1024; not bundled
data.license_notes: Must be obtained from the original dataset owners; not part of this repository.

fit_8gb.notes: NAFNet-width32 GoPro config: 256 crops, batch_size_per_gpu=4, num_gpu=8. Single 8GiB card needs reduced batch/width or accumulation. Width64 is heavier. No measurement was made.

verified_facts: The repository provides train/test configs and a single-image demo command.
The GoPro width32 training config uses 256x256 crops and 8 GPUs.
The model is a general restoration network with no document or seal prior.
limitations: No document/seal-specific training; GoPro/SIDD weights are not suitable for seal ink.
Requires paired degraded/clean data, which the project does not currently have.
Memory and quality on 8GiB are unmeasured.
reuse_for_project: Primary candidate for paired seal restoration after paired data exists.
Export a fixed 256x256 wrapper to TorchScript and integrate behind RESTORE_MODEL_PATH.
Use its PSNR/SSIM pipeline for held-out evaluation.
do_not_use_for_project: Do not claim its GoPro/SIDD numbers for our seal data.
Do not deploy without paired-data validation.
Do not assume weights are licensed exactly like the code.

repos.name: PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
repos.role: Modern seal text detection/recognition pipeline and layout seal class.

weights.license_notes: The repository LICENSE covers code. No separate weight license is stated in the checked docs. HuggingFace model cards could not be reached, so weight terms remain unverified.

fit_8gb.notes: Mobile seal detection plus mobile recognition is small enough for 8GiB; CPU inference is also supported. GPU requires a PaddlePaddle GPU build, not the existing PyTorch/TorchScript runtime.

verified_facts: docs/version3.x/pipeline_usage/seal_recognition.en.md documents a seal text recognition pipeline with seal text detection and a text recognition module.
The pipeline supports curved seal text and optional layout/orientation/unwarping modules.
Layout models include a 'seal' category.
The seal text detection doc states its performance test set is a self-built internal dataset of 500 circular stamps and outputs polygon text boxes, not pixel masks.
The documented use cases are contracts, invoices, warehouse documents and similar modern seals.
Model list and sizes are stated in the seal recognition doc.
limitations: Modern company seals only; no evidence of ancient seal-script (篆书) training or accuracy.
Requires a separate Paddle runtime/service; not a TorchScript drop-in.
Weight license is not separately stated.
A seal layout box is not a pixel-level red mask.
reuse_for_project: Reference design for detection, orientation correction, unwarping, and recognition.
Possible modern-seal-only sidecar service, with human review.
Possible seal region proposal, but only after testing on our crops.
do_not_use_for_project: Do not present it as ancient seal-script OCR.
Do not treat its benchmark Hmean as our accuracy.
Do not package weights before the weight license is confirmed.

repos.name: Gmgge/TrOCR-Seal-Recognition
repos.role: Modern circular company-seal end-to-end OCR training and ONNX inference.

code_license.notes: No LICENSE file exists at the pinned commit; raw LICENSE returned 404. Default copyright applies; reuse is not permitted without explicit permission.

weights.items: TrOCR pretrained/Chinese weights and an exported seal ONNX model
weights.location: Baidu Netdisk and Google Drive links in README
weights.license_notes: No weight license is provided; the repository has no license at all.

data.items: Real circular seal data scraped from the internet, ICDAR 2023 Seal Title, PaddlePaddle community generated data
data.location: Baidu links and ICDAR competition website
data.license_notes: README states the seal-ocr labels were produced by a paid API plus manual verification. Provenance and redistribution rights are unclear.

fit_8gb.notes: TrOCR is roughly 334M parameters; fp32 weights about 1.3GB. README trains with per_device_train_batch_size=8 on a 3090; 8GiB needs batch 1-2 plus accumulation or LoRA (estimate, unmeasured).

verified_facts: The repository provides train.py, eval.py, onnx_test.py, and dictionary/initialization tools.
README describes modern circular seals and horizontal company names.
README warns that real data is insufficient and recommends training on custom data.
requirements.txt pins transformers==4.29.2.
limitations: No license: cannot legally reuse or redistribute as-is.
Modern company seals only; not ancient seal-script glyphs.
Training data is web-scraped with paid-API labels, creating provenance and quality risks.
Old transformers pin conflicts with a modern stack.
reuse_for_project: Technical reference for TrOCR fine-tuning, custom vocabulary, confidence filtering, and ONNX export.
Only usable after explicit permission and after replacing the data with licensed ancient-seal data.
do_not_use_for_project: Do not copy code or weights without a license.
Do not treat modern seal accuracy as ancient seal accuracy.
Do not reuse scraped/paid-API labels for our training.

repos.name: RomanticGodVAN/character-Evolution-Dataset
repos.role: EVOBC oracle-bone character evolution dataset; includes seal-script (SS) glyph samples.

code_license.notes: The repository contains metadata, labels, and documentation only. The To-Do explicitly says data processing code has not been released.

data.in_repo_contents: Key&Value.json labels, List_of_EVOBC.json paths, Statistics.xlsx, CITATION.cff; images are hosted on HuggingFace
data.items: Key&Value.json labels, List_of_EVOBC.json paths, Statistics.xlsx; images hosted on HuggingFace
data.license_notes: LICENSE explicitly declares SPDX CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0: non-commercial and share-alike.

fit_8gb.notes: Dataset-only source; no model to fit.

verified_facts: The repository tree contains only metadata, JSON lists, statistics, citation, README and LICENSE; no images and no code.
README lists OBC, BI, SS, SAC, WSC, CS scripts; SS is Seal Script.
LICENSE is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.
Images are hosted on HuggingFace, not in the repository.
limitations: Oracle-bone evolution dataset, not seal impressions and not red-mask/paired-restoration data.
Non-commercial plus share-alike restricts product use.
No processing code and no OCR/restoration model.
Domain mismatch: single glyph images vs. whole seal crops.
reuse_for_project: Possible auxiliary glyph dictionary/classification resource for seal-script characters, if the project's non-commercial status and share-alike obligations are acceptable.
Label taxonomy reference for ancient scripts.
do_not_use_for_project: Do not treat it as a seal OCR dataset.
Do not use it commercially or without share-alike compliance.
Do not expect detection/restoration training data.

repos.name: VirtualLUOUCAS/Chronicles-OCR
repos.role: Cross-temporal VLM benchmark for seven Chinese scripts, including seal script.

code_license.notes: Apache License 2.0 for the evaluation code.

weights.items: No model weights; inference calls external OpenAI-compatible or local vLLM models.

data.items: 2,800 images across seven scripts, 400 per script
data.license_notes: README says 'This benchmark is released for research purposes only.' This is not a standard open-source data license.

fit_8gb.notes: README examples use a 7B VLM with vLLM; fp16 7B weights alone are about 14GB, exceeding 8GiB. Even a 2B substitute would be evaluation-only.

verified_facts: The repository contains infer.py, judge.py, summarize.py, prompts and judges; no model weights.
README documents seven scripts and 2,800 images.
The documented inference path is OpenAI-compatible API or local vLLM.
The benchmark license statement is research-only.
limitations: Benchmark/evaluation harness, not a trainable restoration or OCR implementation.
Research-only data terms and no weights.
Documented 7B VLLM configuration does not fit 8GiB.
Leaderboard numbers are third-party claims, not measurements on our data.
reuse_for_project: Evaluation protocol and metrics reference for seal-script recognition (spotting, exact match, NED, classification).
Prompt/judge design reference for a later VLM evaluation, not for the core pipeline.
do_not_use_for_project: Do not use as a training source or claim its leaderboard.
Do not deploy the 7B configuration on an 8GiB card.
Do not ignore the research-only data restriction.

repos.name: jingrong-zhang/Art-of-Chinese-Seal-Engraving
repos.role: Dash/Plotly storytelling dashboard about Chinese seal engraving.

data.items: Shanghai Library open data referenced by README; terms not stated in the repository.

repos.rejection_reason: Dashboard/demo only. README describes Python Plotly, Dash, JS/CSS and Esri StoryMaps; it has no OCR, detection, restoration, training, or weights. Not an implementation source.
verified_facts: README describes an online dashboard and a local app.py run via pip install -r requirements.txt.
README credits Shanghai Library open data and lists screenshots.
LICENSE.md is Apache-2.0.

integration_order.title: Record separate runtimes and check export compatibility
actions: Record GPU training Python3.8.5/torch1.13.1+cu116 separately from backend Python3.12/torch2.14.1+cpu.
Our own denoiser export passed a cross-runtime numeric probe; no need to force identical versions.
Validate each external model separately before integration.
integration_order.gate: Reproducible environment record and a smoke test on the target 8GiB GPU.

integration_order.title: Audit crops and build a manual test set
actions: Ignore ._ AppleDouble sidecars; group tzsf_yt_pNNNN crops by source page.
Split train/val/test by page to avoid crop leakage.
Manually annotate 50-100 seals: red mask, visible characters, ancient-script/damage flags; two-person review.
Harness research did not read images. Codex audit/training may read D:/LH/raw_crops locally; never move, rename or modify originals.
integration_order.gate: A held-out, human-reviewed test set with provenance. No synthetic labels.

integration_order.title: Measure the red-mask baseline
actions: Evaluate the existing HSV red mask and Otsu fallback in backend/app/processing.py.
Report IoU, recall, and broken-stroke rate on the manual test set.
Keep seal region detection separate from pixel-level red-mask segmentation.
Use DocDiff masks only after permission, and only as an external evaluation resource.
integration_order.gate: Baseline numbers on our data, not paper numbers.

integration_order.title: Train paired restoration only after pairs exist
actions: Use NAFNet-width32 at 256x256 as the first trainable candidate.
Export a fixed 256x256 TorchScript wrapper for RESTORE_MODEL_PATH.
Run in shadow mode and keep the original image unchanged.
Do not use DocDiff seal_* removal weights for restoration.
integration_order.gate: Held-out PSNR/SSIM and visual review; otherwise keep the 503 path.

integration_order.title: Separate modern-seal OCR from ancient-seal OCR
actions: For modern seals, trial PaddleOCR seal_recognition as a separate Paddle service with human review.
For ancient seal script, build a licensed character/sequence dataset and train a sequence model; the current single-character plugin is insufficient.
Do not train on EVOBC (NC-SA) or TrOCR-Seal data without permission.
integration_order.gate: License review plus CER/exact-match on a held-out ancient-seal test set.

integration_order.title: Evaluate and record provenance
actions: Metrics: mask IoU, CER, whole-seal exact match, restoration PSNR/SSIM only when paired ground truth exists.
Record model SHA256, training-data version, dictionary version, and human-review status.
Reuse the existing ai_inference and human_review_required provenance fields.
integration_order.gate: Reproducible evaluation report; no paper-number substitution.

integration_order.title: Product gate
actions: Enable AI only after P2-P5 thresholds set by the project owner are met.
Label results as AI-assisted and require human review.
Exclude unclear-license weights/data from Docker images and releases.
integration_order.gate: Signed license review and acceptance metrics.

blockers: No human OCR labels or undamaged restoration targets found. Synthetic degradation training is possible with explicitly defined targets; it cannot establish OCR or missing-stroke accuracy.
Our experimental synthetic-noise denoiser is present in models/experimental; production ancient-seal OCR and missing-stroke restoration weights remain unavailable.
Weight licenses for DocDiff, DocEnTR, NAFNet, PaddleOCR and TrOCR-Seal are missing or unverified as separate model-artifact terms.
DocEnTR is CC BY-NC 4.0; EVOBC is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; Chronicles data is research-only; TrOCR-Seal has no LICENSE. These block commercial use.
PaddleOCR and TrOCR-Seal target modern company seals, not ancient seal-script glyphs.
DocDiff seal weights remove seals, the opposite of the intended preservation/restoration.
HuggingFace was unreachable, so PaddleOCR weight cards and dataset cards could not be checked.
Google Drive and Baidu links were not accessed; weight/data availability is based on README/file-tree evidence only.
Separate GPU training and CPU backend runtimes documented; our exported denoiser passes a cross-runtime numeric probe. External model compatibility remains untested.
Our small CNN GPU peak memory was measured. All external repository 8GiB fit statements remain estimates, not measurements.
